response.justification: This candidate is an experienced full-stack and web software engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and general programming craftsmanship, but has no discernible background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, AI accelerator design, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architectures, or low-level performance/power co-design work. The role requires deep hardware-software co-design and chip architecture expertise that is entirely absent from this resume.
strengths: Deep, broad software engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded domains
Strong track record of TDD, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship practices
Some low-latency systems experience (DLang, async I/O, high-performance databases) at Sociomantic
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU/accelerator experience
No evidence of hardware-software co-design, SIMD/MIMD, or chip design collaboration

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / deep-learning performance optimization background
Strong general software engineering and systems background
